title: Interviews with 37 Anduril sources detail safety concerns and project challenges at Anduril's manufacturing operations; Anduril calls the claims "inaccurate" (Paresh Dave/Wired)
summary: Paresh Dave / Wired: Interviews with 37 Anduril sources detail safety concerns and project challenges at Anduril's manufacturing operations; Anduril calls the claims “inaccurate” — From drones to missiles to submarines, the $30.5 billion defense startup wants to transform how the tools of war are made.
